breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 for all torsion calculations and explicitly states 'Do not use the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 anywhere in the torsion calculations.' This directly resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly substituted the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas.
